notes: nothing_stored_excluded lists items where the extractor deliberately stored nothing (an abstention, the safest outcome) -- those are not scored at all. Rates are reported both with and without suspected non-extractions (the model answering the operator instead of extracting). Those items are listed by id; none are silently dropped. gated_rate restates the flags and is not independent evidence the gate works -- false_positive_rate on the legit items is.
